item.title: Christmas Plaid Cat Bed & Dog Bed, Bolster Cushion, Washable — Small
item.description: A warm bed for the spot your pet has already chosen: festive plaid outside, short plush inside with a PP cotton fill, raised bolsters to curl against and red pom-poms along the rim. Warm enough for winter, comfortable all year, in three sizes from cats to labradors.

item.title: Interactive Cat Toy with Bell, Retractable Pom-Pom Wand, Cat Teaser
item.description: Cats play in short bursts. The moment the toy stops moving, most of them walk away — and the usual result is a person crawling under the sofa to retrieve a ball so the game can restart. This toy is built around that one annoyance: the pom-pom stays on a cord that reels in and out of the handle, driven by two buttons. One button launches the ball out across the floor or into the air; a second button winds the cord back in, bringing the pom-pom with it. The cat gets the chase, and you keep the toy in your hand without kneeling down to fetch it. The cord runs on two AAA batteries, which are included. Every toy ships with two pom-poms, and they clip on and off the cord, so a tired or lost ball can be swapped in seconds. A small bell sits on top of each pom-pom, next to the clip — a sound cue that helps a cat follow the ball when it is moving quickly or is out of sight.

item.title: Dog Car Seat & Pet Booster Carrier, Waterproof 2-in-1, Travel — Camel
item.description: A padded seat that straps into the car, lifts out as a carrier, and unzips into a flat bed. Waterproof faux leather wipes clean and does not hold onto hair — for cats and small dogs up to about 10 kg.

item.title: Wall Mounted Cat Scratcher, Sisal Scratching Board, Furniture Protector — Cypress Field
item.description: A scratching board that hangs like a framed painting. Four velcro pads hold it to a wall, a sofa side or a cabinet — and when it comes down it leaves no glue behind. Sisal over an EPS core, 42 × 33 × 3 cm, 650 g.

item.title: Cat Cave Bed, 3-in-1 Triangle Cat Bed & Foldable Indoor Cat Tent
item.description: One corduroy bed in three shapes. Stood up and buttoned together it is a triangle cave with a fleece floor; opened at the back it becomes a sofa; folded down it is a flat sleeping mat. Warm enough for winter in all three.

item.title: Loofah & Silvervine Cat Chew Toy Set, Bread, Cookie & Donut
item.description: Three chew toys shaped like breakfast — a bread loaf, a donut and a star cookie — made from loofah sponge and silvervine, and packed in a printed bakery bag. Cats roll on them, carry them around and chew the ridged surface, which is what gives a kitten's teeth something to work against between meals.

item.title: Plush Squeaky Chew Toys for Puppies & Cats, Machine Washable — Puppy — mint & sunshine
item.description: Plush chew toys with a squeaker buried inside: three puppies, a carrot, a banana, three seahorses and a stingray. Each one is about 21 cm tall and 12 cm wide, weighs 74 g and can go in the washing machine — and the seahorses and the stingray add a cotton rope loop or tail to grab.
